reason: Modifies core group-matching semantics in ShapeResult (used by virtually every display driver for admin/editor tab grouping across all modules), including removing the empty-string filter in the enumerable OnGroup overload, so any driver relying on empty groups being ignored could now behave differently when rendering shapes for specific vs default groups.
